page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance split between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core and single-threaded compression tasks scoring in the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by the stress-ng multi-core score of 11751.7 and a PassMark CPU score of 13262.56. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the average tier, reaching 77.7 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 59.92 GB/sec for write operations.

This hardware profile is suited for workloads that leverage parallel processing rather than raw single-threaded speed. Factual benchmark results show average performance for static web serving at 7.81 GB/sec, Redis SET operations at 11.29 million operations per second, and database operations. It is also capable of handling light LLM inference on small models, though performance drops to weak levels on larger 7B models. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio provide predictable resource density for multi-threaded applications, web serving, and standard database workloads without the premium cost of high-frequency or storage-optimized instances.
